summary.name: Skiff Mail
summary.one_liner: Skiff Mail is an end-to-end encrypted email service with custom domains, unlimited aliases, and a claimed open-source codebase.
use_cases: Use a custom domain for email
Create disposable or private email aliases
Migrate email from Gmail or Outlook
Block email trackers and hide IP address when reading mail
Share email workspaces with a team
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Skiff Mail as end-to-end encrypted email where subject and contents of emails between Skiff users are encrypted, and external mail is encrypted with the user's keys on receipt. It offers custom domains (buy or connect your own) and unlimited aliases that can be added, managed, and deleted. It includes tracker blocking that hides device information and IP address when opening emails. Other listed features are folders, labels, signatures, auto-reply, scheduled and undo send, one-click migration from Gmail, Outlook and ProtonMail, and team workspaces with admin controls.
notable: End-to-end encryption covering both subject and body for emails between Skiff users
10 GB free storage, described as more than other end-to-end encrypted email providers
Unlimited aliases and custom domains (Skiff Domain or your own)
Listed as open source on the page and in awesome-mac as freeware and open-source
caveats: Page text says the codebase is open source, but the exact licence is not stated on the page
Custom domain and team features are described but their pricing is not stated on the page
Free tier scope beyond the 10 GB storage and free scheduled/undo send is not fully specified
